    pv = np.array(p_values, dtype=float)
    n = len(pv)
    sorted_idx = np.argsort(pv)
    ranks = np.empty_like(sorted_idx)
    ranks[sorted_idx] = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    adjusted = np.minimum(1.0, pv * n / ranks)
    # Enforce monotonicity (from largest rank down)
    sorted_adj = adjusted[sorted_idx]
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):

    result = np.empty(n)
    result[sorted_idx] = sorted_adj
